planet_health.Ketu: It is the main cause of painful ulcers and tumors. Ketu is bilious in nature. The diseases are caused by unknown source. It can give consumption, painful fever, wind complaint, diseases of stomach and eyes, ulcers, small pox, piles, surgery, infectious disease, worm or ulcers in intestine. Ketu controls belly and feet. It gives trouble through disputes with Brahmins and Kshatriya.

Mars.mantra: Hanuman Chalisa (Tuesday); Maha Mrityunjaya if surgery risk

Jupiter.mantra: Guru mantra Om Gram Grim Graum Sah Gurave Namah (108x Thursday)

Saturn.mantra: Hanuman Chalisa (Saturday); Shani mantra with guidance
Saturn.charity: Mustard oil, black sesame, serve elderly Saturday
Saturn.gem: Blue sapphire - test 3 days only if advised

Rahu.mantra: Durga Saptashati or Om Durgayai Namah
